message.content:
Build 3 features for Rankora at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora`: WhatsApp Integration, AI Rejection Emails, and API Docs/Keys/Webhooks.

Read CLAUDE.md first. Then read these files: `src/components/CandidateDetailSheet.tsx`, `src/components/KanbanBoard.tsx`, `src/App.tsx`, `src/components/JobSidebar.tsx`, `src/pages/Settings.tsx`, `supabase/functions/rewrite-jd/index.ts`, `supabase/functions/send-candidate-email/index.ts`, `src/components/SidebarLayout.tsx`.

## Feature 1: WhatsApp Integration

### Migration — `supabase/migrations/20260409000000_whatsapp_and_api.sql`
```sql
ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS whatsapp_number text;

CREATE TABLE public.whatsapp_templates (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  team_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name text NOT NULL,
  body text NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
ALTER TABLE public.whatsapp_templates ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Team members view" ON public.whatsapp_templates FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (public.is_team_member(auth.uid(), team_id));
CREATE POLICY "Team admins manage" ON public.whatsapp_templates FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (public.is_team_admin(auth.uid(), team_id));

INSERT INTO public.whatsapp_templates (team_id, name, body)
SELECT t.id, tmpl.name, tmpl.body FROM public.teams t
CROSS JOIN (VALUES
  ('Interview Invite', 'Hi {{candidate_name}}, we reviewed your application for {{job_title}} and would like to invite you for an interview. Are you available this week?'),
  ('Application Update', 'Hi {{candidate_name}}, just an update on your application for {{job_title}}. We are reviewing candidates and will get back to you shortly.'),
  ('Document Request', 'Hi {{candidate_name}}, regarding your application for {{job_title}}, could you please share the following documents? Thanks!'),
  ('Offer Discussion', 'Hi {{candidate_name}}, great news about {{job_title}}! We would like to discuss an offer. When works for you?')
) AS tmpl(name, body);
```

### New: `src/components/candidate/WhatsAppButton.tsx`
- Props: phone (string|null), candidateName, jobTitle, size ("sm"|"default")
- If no phone: disabled with tooltip
- Clean phone, generate `https://wa.me/${phone}?text=${encoded}`, open in new tab
- Green MessageCircle icon

### New: `src/components/candidate/WhatsAppDialog.tsx`
- Fetch templates from whatsapp_templates for team
- Template picker → preview with {{variables}} replaced → editable textarea
- "Open WhatsApp" + "Copy Message" buttons

### Integrate into CandidateDetailSheet: add WhatsApp button in action bar

## Feature 2: AI Rejection Emails

### Edge Function — `supabase/functions/generate-rejection/index.ts`
Copy auth/CORS pattern from rewrite-jd. Auth required, no credits.
- Input: {candidate_name, job_title, strengths[], gaps[], missing_skills[], overall_score}
- GPT-4o, json_object format, empathetic HR tone
- Output: {subject, body}

### New: `src/components/candidate/RejectWithFeedbackDialog.tsx`
- On open: call generate-rejection
- Loading → editable subject+body → "Send & Reject" or "Just Reject"
- Send via send-candidate-email, update stage to rejected
- "Use simple template" toggle

### Integrate into CandidateDetailSheet: "Reject with Feedback" button

## Feature 3: API Docs + Keys + Webhooks

### Migration — `supabase/migrations/20260409100000_api_keys_and_webhooks.sql`
```sql
CREATE TABLE public.api_keys (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  team_id uuid REFERENCES public.teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Default',
  key_prefix text NOT NULL,
  key_hash text NOT NULL,
  last_used_at timestamptz,
  revoked boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX idx_api_keys_hash ON public.api_keys(key_hash);
ALTER TABLE public.api_keys ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Users manage own keys" ON public.api_keys FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (user_id = auth.uid());

CREATE TABLE public.webhook_configs (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  team_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  url text NOT NULL,
  events text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  secret text,
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
ALTER TABLE public.webhook_configs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Team admins manage" ON public.webhook_configs FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (public.is_team_admin(auth.uid(), team_id));
CREATE POLICY "Team members view" ON public.webhook_configs FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (public.is_team_member(auth.uid(), team_id));
```

### New: `src/pages/ApiDocs.tsx`
- SidebarLayout, max-w-5xl, Tabs: "API Keys" | "Documentation" | "Webhooks"

### New: `src/components/ApiKeyManager.tsx`
- Generate: `rk_live_${randomUUID}`, hash with SHA-256 via Web Crypto, store prefix+hash
- Show full key once with copy button + warning
- List: name, prefix, created, last_used, revoke
- Max 5 keys

### API Reference section (inline in ApiDocs)
- Static docs: endpoints (list_jobs, get_job, get_results, create_job)
- Code examples: curl, JS, Python
- Styled Cards per endpoint with method badge

### Edge Function — `supabase/functions/public-api/index.ts`
- CORS *, validates Bearer token by hashing + DB lookup
- Updates last_used_at, routes by `action` param
- Actions: list_jobs, get_job, get_results, create_job
- Rate limit: in-memory 100/min per key

### New: `src/components/WebhookManager.tsx`
- Props: teamId
- List webhooks, add form (URL + event checkboxes), test button, active toggle

### Sidebar: add "API" (Code icon) to settingsNav
### App.tsx: add /api-docs route (ProtectedRoute, eager import)

## Constraints
- NEVER edit `src/integrations/supabase/types.ts`
- `(supabase as any)` for new tables
- `@/` imports, shadcn-ui only, Sonner toasts
- max-w-5xl consistent
- Run `npm run build` — zero errors
